title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior diffuses through a population under social influence, information exposure, and policy interventions.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: People observe and are influenced by mask-wearing of their social contacts and co-located others.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations and authorities enforce mask mandates with warnings or fines, affecting individual compliance.

interactions.name: information_dissemination
interactions.description: Media broadcasts and official guidance update individuals' risk perception and attitudes.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: Individuals acquire masks from retailers subject to price, inventory, and rationing constraints.

interactions.name: mobility_and_contact
interactions.description: Individuals travel to locations (home, work, school, public) creating opportunities for observation and norm diffusion.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: time_to_target_adoption
metrics.description: Days taken to reach a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: peak_adoption_level
metrics.description: Maximum adoption rate achieved during the simulation.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_level
metrics.description: Average adoption rate over the final evaluation window.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_index
metrics.description: Disparities in adoption across demographic groups or locations (e.g., Gini or variance).

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Difference in adoption attributable to mandates/enforcement versus a counterfactual without policy.

metrics.name: mask_shortage_incidents
metrics.description: Count of time steps where demand exceeds retailer inventory.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_of_adoption
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate change falls below 0.5 percentage points per day for 7 consecutive days.

validation_criteria.name: target_adoption_threshold
validation_criteria.description: Simulation achieves at least 70% adoption within the time horizon under mandate-on scenario.

validation_criteria.name: no_inventory_negatives
validation_criteria.description: Retailer inventory levels remain non-negative during all time steps.
